definitions.gloss: door-to-door inquiry, canvassing for information, investigation by questioning
definitions.explanation: The act of going around asking people for information, especially by police investigating a crime. A standard part of detective work in Japanese crime fiction and news reporting.

examples.japanese: ⟦{刑事|けいじ}→刑事：02741_keiji⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{聞|き}き{込|こ}み⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{回|まわ}る→回る：01150_mawaru⟧。
examples.english: The detective goes around conducting inquiries.

examples.japanese: ⟦{近所|きんじょ}→近所：01318_kinjo⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{聞|き}き{込|こ}み⟦{調査|ちょうさ}→調査：03489_chousa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}った→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: They conducted door-to-door inquiries in the neighborhood.

examples.japanese: {聞|き}き{込|こ}み⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧、⟦{事件|じけん}→事件：01568_jiken⟧⟦{当日|とうじつ}→当日：04558_toujitsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{不審|ふしん}→不審：16934_fushin⟧な⟦{人物|じんぶつ}→人物：03356_jinbutsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}た→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦という→という：09577_toiu⟧⟦{証言|しょうげん}→証言：11088_shougen⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{得|え}られた→得る：02014_eru⟧。
examples.english: As a result of the door-to-door inquiries, they obtained a testimony that a suspicious person was seen on the day of the incident.

notes:
USAGE:
Strongly associated with police investigations. Very commonly heard in crime dramas, mystery novels, and news reports. The verb form is {聞|き}き{込|こ}み⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {聞|き}き{込|こ}み⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (conduct inquiries)
- {聞|き}き{込|こ}み⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{回|まわ}る→回る：01150_mawaru⟧ (go around asking questions)
- {聞|き}き{込|こ}み⟦{調査|ちょうさ}→調査：03489_chousa⟧ (inquiry-based investigation)
- {聞|き}き{込|こ}み⟦{捜査|そうさ}→捜査：03688_sousa⟧ (investigation through questioning)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{取材|しゅざい}→取材：05227_shuzai⟧: news-gathering, reporting (journalistic context)
- {尋問|じんもん}: interrogation (more formal, at the station)
